findings.issue: exact integer PRODUCT was suppressed under real approximation latitude
findings.resolution: exact non-overflowing integer plans for no DIM, DIM= and MASK=, plus the zero-size identity 1 with a non-vacuous companion; latitude kept only for real/complex

findings.issue: RANDOM_SEED plan asserted SIZE > 0, which the text does not require
findings.resolution: removed; the plan only uses the reported N to size GET/PUT arrays

findings.issue: RANDOM_INIT 'different sequence' was tested by finite-prefix inequality
findings.resolution: removed; no finite prefix is required to differ, so 'different' has no portable oracle

findings.issue: distinct PUT arrays were assumed to give distinct sequences
findings.resolution: removed; only the p5 GET/PUT equivalence ('shall result in the same sequence') is planned
